preconditions.description: The number of rows n is between 3 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of columns m is between 3 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of starting positions k is between 1 and the minimum of n*m and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(row in {'.', '*'} for row in museum)
preconditions.description: Each row in the museum contains only '.' or '*' characters.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in start_positions)
preconditions.description: Each starting position (x, y) is within the bounds of the museum.

preconditions.expression: all(museum[x-1][y-1] == '.' for x, y in start_positions)
preconditions.description: Each starting position is an empty cell marked with '.'.

postconditions.description: The number of results is equal to the number of starting positions k.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(0 <= result <= 2 * (n + m - 2) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is between 0 and 2 * (n + m - 2) inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == max_pictures_seen(museum, x, y) for (x, y), result in zip(start_positions, results))
postconditions.description: Each result is the maximum number of pictures Igor can see starting from the corresponding position.
